recent.reason: AJC International, Inc. Recalls Frozen, Raw Pork Products Imported Without Benefit of Import Reinspection. AJC International, Inc., the importer of record located in Atlanta, Ga., is recalling approximately 17,428 pounds of frozen, raw pork products that were not presented for import reinspection into the United States, the U.S. Department of Agriculture’s Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS) announced today.
